note: Cross-repo contract topology. Pointers only - no schema content, no hashes, no values. Hashes and extracted values live in each consumer's .contracts.lock.json, written by tools/skkuverse_sync.py. This file changes only when the SET of contracts changes.

contracts.note: A transform, not a byte copy of sources.json: hasCategory/hasAuthor are derived from `strategy` via STRATEGY_FEATURES. Compare against the generated artifact, never against the SSOT.
picker sourceIds are filtered (crawlAvailable OR excludeReason != null), so this differs structurally from categories.json.
List -> {id: label} map. tabconfig.service.ts already fails boot if a sources.json excludeReason has no entry here - that is a partial-copy detector, not a drift detector.

Points at the generated artifact rather than categories.json because the app must mirror what the SERVER emits, and gen_server_categories filters. Today the id/tabMode projection is identical in both. Adding a fixed tab without updating the app mirror is otherwise undetectable - the symptom is zero notifications sent, no error.

Verified that the generator reproduces the current hand-typed FIXED_TAB_KEYS/KNOWN_PICKER_KEYS exactly, so adoption is a zero-diff change - but it must be based on skkuverse-app `dev`, whose tabsContract.ts already differs from `main`. Sequence it after that branch converges.

contracts.note: Direction matters. The Cloud Function 400s any payload above MAX_TOPICS, so server TOPIC_CAP must stay <= app MAX_TOPICS. `lte` rather than `eq` is what keeps the ADR-0005 deploy order (app first) green at every intermediate step. See skkuverse-server/docs/decisions/0005-notice-dispatch-content-group.md.
contracts.blockedBy: MAX_TOPICS exists only on skkuverse-app `dev` (PR #18), not on the `main` this contract tracks - while the deployed Cloud Function does have it, since the app has no deploy workflow and ships by hand. So app `main` is behind both `dev` and production, and server TOPIC_CAP=30 is currently guarded by a constant that no tracked branch carries. Activating this now would fail closed, correctly. Unblock: merge skkuverse-app dev -> main, then flip to active and run `pull --repo server`.
